text:
Samira (CS): Heads up — planning a 2-part 'Deep‑Dive Clinic' for the Novus migration customers next week. Focus: Dedicated migrations + preflight checklist. Need to lock times for NA and APAC windows. Quick poll below.

Liam (Solutions): Love it. Can we do a short demo of the autoscale config + canary rollout? I can run the demo. ETA: ~20m.

Priya (Customer Success): Count me in. Suggested slots: Tue 2026-04-14 09:00 PT (NA) or Wed 2026-04-15 08:00 SGT (APAC). Which works? Reply with :one: for Tue, :two: for Wed or propose other times.

Mateo (SE): Prefer Tue morning NA. Also want to cover KV cache warmup patterns (5m).

Samira (CS): Noted. If Tue is the NA slot, we still need an APAC-friendly one. Can we do APAC at Wed 08:00 SGT? That would be Tue 16:00 UTC. Thoughts?

Priya (Customer Success): Wed 08:00 SGT works for our APAC customers. I'll coordinate invites. @Onboarding Bot can you create calendar events for both slots with the agenda?

Onboarding Bot: Event created: 'Deep‑Dive Clinic — Novus Migration (NA)' Tue 2026-04-14 09:00 PT — 1hr. Event link: https://calendar.redwood.ai/e/abc123. Also created 'Deep‑Dive Clinic — Novus Migration (APAC)' Wed 2026-04-15 08:00 SGT — 1hr.

Samira (CS): Agenda draft: 1) Welcome + customer intros (5m) 2) Migration checklist walkthrough (10m) 3) Autoscale & canary demo (20m) 4) KV cache warmups + perf tips (10m) 5) Q&A + next steps (15m). Please flag changes.

Liam (Solutions): I'll slot in a short slide for 'fallback routing' at the 5m mark. Can someone add a note to record the session for folks behind firewalls?

Priya (Customer Success): Recording yes. Also add feedback pulse: tiny 3-question form after session. I'll attach link: https://forms.redwood.ai/s/novus-clinic-feedback

Mateo (SE): Prep checklist for SEs: attach sample config snippet. I'll paste it here: ```yaml
autoscale:
  min_replicas: 1
  max_replicas: 8
  target_rps: 120
cache:
  prefix_caching: true
  warmup_seconds: 30
```

Samira (CS): :thumbsup: Perfect. Final ask — who can take the post-session follow-up (notes + action items)? @Priya volunteer? @Liam can you capture demo logs?

Priya (Customer Success): I'll own follow-up notes and action items.

Liam (Solutions): I can capture demo logs and drop into the session thread.

Samira (CS): Thanks team. I'll push the invites and post the final agenda by EOD Fri. Ping in thread if anything else. :rocket:
